summary: Xbox Game Studios' racing franchise, covering the Motorsport simulation line, the Horizon open-world line, and discontinued mobile/computer spin-offs.

emulation.notes: Use original hardware if compatibility is not acceptable.

primary.why: The first Forza Motorsport shipped only on the original Xbox.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or a verified Xbox emulation setup with a dumped disc.

emulation.notes: Original Xbox 360 hardware remains the compatibility baseline.

primary.why: Forza Motorsport 2 shipped only on Xbox 360.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware or a verified Xbox 360 emulation setup.

emulation.notes: Original Xbox 360 hardware remains the compatibility baseline.

primary.why: Forza Motorsport 3 shipped only on Xbox 360.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware or a verified Xbox 360 emulation setup.

emulation.notes: Original Xbox 360 hardware remains the compatibility baseline.

primary.why: Forza Motorsport 4 shipped only on Xbox 360.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware or a verified Xbox 360 emulation setup.

emulation.notes: Original or backward-compatible Xbox hardware is preferred for reliability.

primary.why: The first Forza Horizon shipped for Xbox 360; it is now delisted, so preservation depends on an owned copy.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Xbox 360 copy on Xbox 360 or compatible Xbox hardware; online servers ended in 2023.

emulation.notes: Use Xbox One or Xbox Series backward compatibility.

primary.why: Forza Motorsport 5 shipped on Xbox One and remains an Xbox console route through backward compatibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Xbox One copy on Xbox One or backward-compatible Xbox Series hardware.

entries.title: Forza Horizon 2

emulation.notes: Use Xbox One or Xbox Series backward compatibility.

primary.why: Forza Horizon 2 shipped on Xbox 360 and Xbox One; the Xbox One version is the higher-fidelity primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Xbox One copy on Xbox One or compatible Xbox Series hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted status may affect acquisition; use an owned copy.

entries.title: Forza Motorsport 6

emulation.notes: Use Xbox One or Xbox Series backward compatibility.

primary.why: The full Forza Motorsport 6 release shipped on Xbox One; the Windows Apex release is a separate free special edition and is cataloged separately.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Xbox One copy on Xbox One or Xbox Series backward compatibility.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute Apex for the full game.

entries.title: Forza Motorsport 6: Apex

primary.why: Apex is the Windows free-to-play special edition associated with Forza Motorsport 6, so Windows is its only sourced platform.
primary.how_to_play: Preserve an existing Windows installation; storefront availability may be limited due licensing/delisting.

entries.remaster_caveats: Catalog separately from the full Xbox One game.

entries.title: Forza Horizon 3

primary.why: Forza Horizon 3 shipped on Xbox One and Windows; Windows is the more flexible fidelity route and supports cross-play with Xbox One.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Windows 10 copy with all owned DLC installed; the game has been delisted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted status may affect acquisition; preserve owned DLC/installers.

entries.title: Forza Motorsport 7

primary.why: Forza Motorsport 7 shipped on Windows and Xbox One; Windows is the more flexible fidelity and capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Windows copy with final updates and owned DLC; the game has been delisted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted status may affect acquisition; preserve owned DLC/installers.

entries.title: Forza Horizon 4

primary.why: Forza Horizon 4 shipped on Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S; Windows is the flexible fidelity route, but ownership matters after delisting.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Windows copy with all owned DLC installed; preserve the final update state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted; preserve owned content and final update state.

entries.title: Forza Street

primary.why: Forza Street launched as a Windows 10 Forza title before its iOS and Android versions; servers shut down in April 2022.
primary.how_to_play: No current public play route; preserve only for historical documentation if an installed client and data are already archived.

entries.remaster_caveats: Discontinued service; do not recommend as a current play route.

entries.title: Forza Horizon 5

primary.why: Forza Horizon 5 is available on Windows, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, cloud, and PS5; Windows is the most flexible route and supports the complete expansion package.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version through Steam or the Xbox app with Hot Wheels, Rally Adventure, and owned car-pass content installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live/current-update state matters; preserve owned DLC and patch version.

entries.title: Forza Motorsport (2023)

primary.why: The 2023 Forza Motorsport reboot shipped on Windows and Xbox Series X/S; Windows is the flexible high-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version via Steam or the Xbox app with owned DLC installed and the current patch noted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live/current-update state matters; preserve patch version.

entries.title: Forza Customs

primary.why: Forza Customs launched worldwide on Android and iOS, then was sunset and removed from stores in 2025; Android is chosen as the practical installed-client preservation target.
primary.how_to_play: No new official install route after the March 10, 2025 sunset; only already installed copies remain playable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Discontinued and delisted; not a normal current acquisition route.

entries.title: Forza Horizon 6

primary.why: Forza Horizon 6 is available now on Windows and Xbox Series X/S, with PS5 announced for later in 2026; Windows is the current highest-configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version via Steam or the Xbox app; note the patch version because the game is actively updated.

entries.remaster_caveats: Active live title; preserve patch version. PS5 post-launch release is pending as of 2026-06-15.
